title: bigelovia verticillata
intro: Bigelovia verticillata, commonly known as Blue Mountain mint, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Bigelovia verticillata include its ability to aid digestion, reduce fever, and soothe respiratory issues. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils.
